vagas.description:
• Experiência em posições de liderança executiva (gerência geral ou diretoria)
  • Forte domínio em gestão financeira, administrativa e análise de investimentos

Sobre nosso cliente

Grupo empresarial familiar com mais de 15 anos de atuação na Bahia, focado em gestão patrimonial, investimentos imobiliários e projetos com visão estratégica, sustentabilidade e urbanismo.

Descrição

  • Atuar como principal executivo do grupo, liderando a operação e a equipe de cerca de 10 colaboradores. Garantindo o alinhamento entre estratégia, execução e reporte ao conselho de sócios.
  • Implementar práticas de governança e atuar na formação de uma cultura empresarial mais estruturada.
  • Consolidar e estruturar relatórios financeiros, operacionais e estratégicos para a governança do negócio.
  • Conduzir processos de investimento e expansão, com foco em análise de viabilidade, retorno e compliance.
  • Estruturar e acompanhar os empreendimentos imobiliários (compra, reforma, locação, incorporações e loteamentos).
  • Atuar na interface com parceiros externos (ex: Coelba, fornecedores, parceiros imobiliários e jurídicos).
  • Propor melhorias na gestão de dados e informações para tomada de decisão estratégica.
  • Ser interlocutor executivo entre a operação e os sócios, assumindo protagonismo na execução das estratégias do grupo.
  • Ter disponibilidade para deslocamentos pontuais às demais cidades com ativos ou projetos (Itabuna, Eunápolis etc.).

Perfil desejável

  • Formação superior em Administração, Engenharia, Economia, Finanças ou áreas correlatas.
  • Pós-graduação ou MBA em Finanças, Gestão Empresarial ou áreas afins será considerado diferencial.
  • Sólida experiência como executivo em empresas com múltiplas frentes operacionais ou familiares em fase de estruturação.
  • Vivência com gestão administrativa-financeira, planejamento orçamentário, estruturação de relatórios gerenciais e suporte à tomada de decisão.
  • Conhecimento em incorporação imobiliária, engenharia financeira ou estruturação de projetos será altamente valorizado.
  • Perfil de liderança com maturidade, capacidade de influenciar, organizar processos e imprimir ritmo à equipe.
  • Habilidade para atuar com autonomia e em contato direto com sócios e conselhos.
  • Experiência prévia em empresas com estrutura mais formal será um diferencial, especialmente se trouxer bagagem de governança e inteligência organizacional replicável.
  • Profissional com espírito empreendedor, visão analítica e liderança colaborativa.

O que está sendo ofertado

  • Salário compatível com o mercado.
  • Forma de contratação: PJ.

vagas.title: Auxiliar Governança - Gestão Governança (Hotelaria) - Hospital Aeroporto
vagas.description:
Descrição

Requisitos:

  • Formação: Mínimo Ensino Médio Completo
  • Desejável experiência com atendimento ao público

Atividades

  • Liberar os leitos após desinfecção terminal, com aplicação do checklist, identificando não conformidades a serem corrigidas;
  • Verificar as condições de limpeza de todo o ambiente e, quando necessário, acionar a supervisora de higienização/encarregada;
  • Realizar a abertura do chamado para o setor de manutenção quando houver necessidade de conserto/reparos de móveis e equipamentos dos leitos e áreas comuns;
  • Realizar entrega de controles de TVs e ar condicionado;
  • Iniciar e finalizar altas no sistema Tasy e informar à gestão de leitos, incluindo leitos bloqueados;
  • Realizar visitas diárias nas unidades de internamento e preencher o formulário de visitas;
  • Realizar o teste de limpeza após desinfecção terminal, com luminol ou ATP, e informar o resultado por e-mail;
  • Apoiar a supervisora de governança na medição do SLA do serviço de higiene e resíduos;
  • Realizar levantamentos de itens com danos ou necessidade de reposição da UNI, sempre que necessário;
  • Apoiar na entrega de enxovais da Rouparia quando necessário;
  • Auxiliar nos eventos de hotelaria, organização do espaço e entrega de brindes aos clientes;
  • Contribuir com a supervisora de governança no processo de formação de novos colaboradores, através de treinamentos práticos e acompanhamento;
  • Participar do inventário de enxoval do hospital, tanto na unidade quanto na lavanderia, realizando a contagem e registro em formulário "Inventário do Enxoval".

Outras Informações

  • Local de trabalho: Hospital Aeroporto (Lauro de Freitas)
  • Escala de trabalho: 4 vagas disponíveis, total de 180 horas/mês, sendo 2 vagas em plantão 12x36 (07h às 19h) e 2 em plantão 12x36 (19h às 07h)
  • Disponibilidade para treinamento

vagas.title: Engenheiro de Dados – ETL/BI
vagas.description:
Job Description:

We are seeking a talented ETL/BI Engineer to design, develop, and maintain robust data pipelines, semantic models, and business intelligence solutions. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with AWS Glue, Amazon Redshift, and building modern semantic layers using tools like LookML (Looker) and Cube. You will be instrumental in shaping scalable data architecture, enabling self-service analytics, and delivering reliable insights across the organization.

Fluent English is required , as this role involves collaboration with international teams and stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, implement, and optimize ETL workflows using AWS Glue and other AWS services.
  • Build and maintain data warehouses using Amazon Redshift, ensuring scalability, performance, and cost-efficiency.
  • Develop and manage semantic layers using LookML (Looker) and Cube to standardize metrics and simplify data access for business users.
  • Create scalable, reusable data models and data marts to support analytics and reporting needs.
  • Collaborate closely with data analysts, engineers, and stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
  • Ensure data integrity, quality, and consistency across the full data lifecycle.
  • Automate and monitor data integration workflows, and maintain comprehensive documentation.

Qualifications:

  • 3+ years of experience with ETL/ELT processes and cloud-based data pipelines, especially using AWS Glue.
  • Strong proficiency in Amazon Redshift, including data modeling and query performance optimization.
  • Hands-on experience with LookML for Looker semantic modeling.
  • Familiarity or experience with Cube ( for building headless BI and semantic APIs is highly desirable.
  • Proficiency in SQL and scripting languages (e.g., Python).
  • Experience with BI tools such as Looker, QuickSight, Tableau, or Power BI.
  • Solid understanding of data governance, lineage, and metadata management.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills.
  • Fluent English required.

vagas.title: Arquiteto  ServiceNow
vagas.description:
A Inetum é uma empresa líder global em serviços de TI, dedicada a fornecer soluções inovadoras aos nossos clientes. Estamos comprometidos em promover um ambiente de trabalho dinâmico, inclusivo e que preza pela diversidade, onde a criatividade e a colaboração prosperem. Estamos presentes em 19 países e somos mais de 28.000 colaboradores no mundo.

Se você está em busca de uma empresa dinâmica, inovadora e tecnológica , a Inetum é o seu lugar!

Vem ser Inetum !


Estamos em busca de um(a) Arquiteto(a) ServiceNow com perfil analítico, proativo e apaixonado por inovação, para atuar na melhoria contínua da plataforma e no atendimento de chamados técnicos .

Essa posição é estratégica para garantir a excelência na experiência do usuário e a evolução constante da nossa plataforma ServiceNow, por meio da automação de processos, integração de sistemas e implementação de melhorias técnicas.


Responsabilidades

Desenvolver e implementar melhorias na plataforma ServiceNow com foco em inovação e eficiência;

Atender chamados técnicos, analisando e solucionando problemas com agilidade e qualidade;

Criar, revisar e otimizar workflows automatizados ;

Integrar o ServiceNow com outros sistemas corporativos;

Interagir com áreas de negócio para levantar requisitos e propor soluções técnicas viáveis;

Garantir conformidade com boas práticas de segurança e governança de TI .


Requisitos

  • Experiência sólida com a plataforma ServiceNow : administração, configuração e desenvolvimento;
  • Conhecimento técnico em ITSM , CMDB , automação de processos e integrações;
  • Atuação em atendimento técnico e resolução de chamados ;
  • Habilidade com scripts , regras de negócio, configurações e workflows;
  • Familiaridade com APIs REST/SOAP e integrações com outros sistemas;
  • Perfil colaborativo, com boa comunicação e capacidade de atuação multidisciplinar.


Diferenciais

  • Certificações ServiceNow : CSA, CIS, CAD;
  • Experiência em integrações complexas via APIs ;
  • Conhecimento em ITIL e boas práticas de governança de TI.


Informações Adicionais:

  • Híbrido, 2 dias presenciais em São Paulo

vagas.title: Junior Node Developer - Remote
vagas.description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


About the Role:

We are looking for Junior Node Developers to join our Development team and participate in different projects made up of multicultural teams distributed throughout the world. We are looking for proactive people, team players passionate about programming in this language and oriented to provide the best experience to the end user. This is an excellent opportunity for those professionals looking to develop in one of the fastest growing companies in the industry!


These developers will face numerous technical challenges, so they must use current technologies, get involved in the mobile world, web applications, devices, etc.


Main Activities:

- Architect Bandit backend systems using the best practice.

- Implement and iterate features in a tactical manner and rapid pace.

- Work collaboratively and efficiently across functional teams in a fast paced early stage startup environment.

- Design, extend, and implement APIs.

- High standard of engineering quality through code reviews, unit tests, analytics.

- Create engineering efficiencies through automation and development of tools.

- Define engineering processes for product launch and releases.

- Help us grow the world class engineering team via by running technical interviews.


Requirements:

- 1+ year of experience in Node development.

- Experience in Video and HLS.

- Advanced English level.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

vagas.title: SR Fullstack Developer TypeScript/AWS
vagas.description:
Muito prazer, somos a Zallpy!

Somos muito mais que uma empresa de tecnologia; somos uma comunidade diversa, plural e talentosa. Nosso propósito é liderar a transformação digital, com excelência e agilidade, promovendo crescimento mútuo e genuíno em relações éticas e duradouras. Flexibilidade é uma de nossas marcas registradas, atuamos em diferentes modelos e formatos de equipe, mantendo nossa cultura leve, colaborativa e integrada, proporcionando equidade de oportunidades em um espaço onde todos se sintam seguros e ouvidos.


O que você vai fazer:

  • Desenvolver back-end em Node.js / NestJS com boas práticas de arquitetura.
  • Evoluir o front-end em React ou Angular, cuidando de estrutura, estado e performance.
  • Criar infraestrutura previsível com Terraform (Terragrunt é bem-vindo).
  • Ajustar AWS para alta disponibilidade e custo eficiente (Lambda, ECS / K8s, RDS, CloudWatch).
  • Automatizar CI/CD em GitHub Actions ou Jenkins e aplicar deploys progressivos (blue-green, canary).
  • Acompanhar métricas, SLI/SLO, observabilidade (ELK, Prometheus, Grafana) e participar de post-mortems.


O que estamos buscando:

  • Experiência sólida com JavaScript / TypeScript em produção.
  • Vivência desenhando soluções completas (código, infra, pipeline e deploy).
  • Conhecimento prático de AWS e Terraform.
  • Familiaridade com Docker e orquestração (Kubernetes/ECS) ou serverless (Lambda + API Gateway).
  • Conforto em montar ou manter pipelines CI/CD.
  • Noções de tuning em PostgreSQL ou SQL Server.
  • Inglês avançado para atuação em projeto internacional.


Será um diferencial se você:

  • Terragrunt em multi-account.
  • Experiência extra em GCP ou Azure.
  • Tracing distribuído (OpenTelemetry).
  • Padrões como DDD, CQRS ou Event Sourcing.
  • Contribuição em projetos open-source ou talks técnicas.


Onde você vai trabalhar:

  • Esta é uma posição para atuação 100% remota.


Modalidade de contratação:

  • CLT.
  • Cooperado.


O que oferecemos:

Vale Alimentação/Refeição: Utilizamos o cartão multibenefício EVA, em formato crédito, para proporcionar flexibilidade nas suas compras diárias.*

Plano de Saúde Unimed: Sem coparticipação ou carência para o titular. Dependentes como filhos, cônjuges ou enteados podem ser incluídos com coparticipação.*

Flexibilidade é uma de nossas marcas registradas, atuamos em diferentes modelos e formatos de equipe, mantendo nossa cultura leve, colaborativa e integrada, proporcionando equidade de oportunidades em um espaço onde todos se sintam seguros e ouvidos.


O que você vai fazer:

  • Desenvolver back-end em Node.js / NestJS com boas práticas de arquitetura.
  • Evoluir o front-end em React ou Angular, cuidando de estrutura, estado e performance.
  • Criar infraestrutura previsível com Terraform (Terragrunt é bem-vindo).
  • Ajustar AWS para alta disponibilidade e custo eficiente (Lambda, ECS / K8s, RDS, CloudWatch).
  • Automatizar CI/CD em GitHub Actions ou Jenkins e aplicar deploys progressivos (blue-green, canary).
  • Acompanhar métricas, SLI/SLO, observabilidade (ELK, Prometheus, Grafana) e participar de post-mortems.


O que estamos buscando:

  • Experiência sólida com JavaScript / TypeScript em produção.
  • Vivência desenhando soluções completas (código, infra, pipeline e deploy).

  • Conforto em montar ou manter pipelines CI/CD.

vagas.title: Content Programming & Strategy Specialist
vagas.description:
About us:


Touch, a Conetic Group company, is a disruptive Content Service Provider focused on delivering exceptional onboard experiences for aircraft and the broader transportation industry.


Established in 2011, Touch is headquartered in Miami, with an additional main office in Portugal.


At Touch, we understand what makes airlines unique and deliver timely, effective solutions to support them in achieving excellence.


We’re an agile, young-minded, and service-oriented company, always at the forefront of industry innovation. Our qualified, resourceful, and empowered team breathes respect for airlines, suppliers, and one another.


About the role:


As our Content Programming and Strategy Specialist, you will create conceptual content curation strategies that consider targeted audiences, consumer habits, and global/ regional content trends. You will design concepts aligned with airline markets and our global brand strategy, as well as sort and select content (films, TV shows, music, etc.) for various in-flight entertainment systems.

The Content Programming and Strategy Specialist must also support the other Touch teams to secure contractual obligations (SLA’s and KPI’s) are being met and keep Touch headquarters always updated about the customer perception on the quality of the service delivered.


About the responsibilities:


  • Create conceptual content curation strategies contemplating targeted audiences, consumer habits and overall global/regional content trends;
  • Design content concepts aligned with the Airline markets and global business strategy;
  • Understand airlines passenger profiles to properly tailor an assertive content strategy;
  • Sort and select content (Film&TV, regional and special content) for different systems;
  • Manage and utilize data insights to create coherent content curation;
  • Generate content license negotiations with distributors and content creators;
  • Develop special projects and propose innovation through strategic partnerships with relevant content creators and brands;
  • Seek innovative opportunities that brings value and differentiation for the Airline’s Inflight Entertainment platforms;
  • Involvement on product development features, focused on content management for the company and customers;
  • Produce assertive content strategies based on personalized passenger profiles.


About you:


  • Based in Chile;
  • Fluent in Spanish and English;
  • High school diploma/GED (Bachelor's degree is a plus);
  • Experience in the airline or entertainment industry is a plus;
  • Customer service experience is a plus;
  • Comfortable delivering internal and external presentations;
  • Ability to manage people and lead projects;
  • Strong multitasking and prioritization skills;
  • Self-starter with excellent problem-solving abilities;
  • Clear and effective communicator;
  • Leadership mindset;
  • Strong time management skills;
  • Adaptability;
  • Strategic thinker;
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office, Excel, and Keynote.


About the benefits:


  • Flexible working hours;
  • International team;
  • Birthday Leave.

vagas.title: Node Developer - Remote
vagas.description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the Role:


Are you ready to join a dynamic Development team and take on diverse projects with multicultural teams worldwide? We're seeking Node Developers who are proactive, collaborative team players passionate about programming and dedicated to delivering exceptional user experiences. This is an exciting opportunity to grow with one of the fastest-growing companies in the industry!


Responsibilities:


Q: What will you do as a Node Developer?

A: You'll architect Bandit backend systems using the best practices available. You'll implement and iterate on features swiftly and strategically, adapting to the demands of our fast-paced startup environment.


Q: How will you contribute to API design and implementation?

A: You'll play a crucial role in designing, extending, and implementing APIs to ensure robust functionality and seamless integration across platforms.


Q: How do you maintain engineering quality?

A: You'll uphold high standards through rigorous code reviews, comprehensive unit testing, and insightful analytics to drive continuous improvement.


Q: What role does automation play in your work?

A: Automating processes and developing tools will be key to enhancing engineering efficiency and productivity.


Q: How will you influence engineering processes?

A: You'll define and refine engineering processes to support successful product launches and releases, ensuring our solutions meet the highest standards.


Q: How can you help us expand our engineering team?

A: Conducting technical interviews will allow you to contribute to the growth of our world-class engineering team, bringing in top talent to drive our success.


Requirements:


Q: How much experience is required?

A: You should have a minimum of 5 years of experience in Node development, demonstrating your expertise and proficiency in the field.


Q: What specific expertise is needed in addition to Node development?

A: Experience in Video and HLS (HTTP Live Streaming) will be essential for addressing the diverse technical challenges you'll encounter.


Q: What language skills are necessary?

A: Proficiency in advanced English is required to effectively communicate and collaborate with our global teams and clients.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

vagas.title: Go To Market Lead
vagas.description:
Go to Market Lead (Americas) – Exciting Opportunity in Brazil!


Are you a strategic thinker with a passion for driving growth? We’re seeking an experienced Go to Market Lead to shape and deliver compelling customer value propositions across the Americas. This dynamic role sits at the heart of Product, Sales, and Marketing, where you’ll craft tailored strategies, lead launches, and bridge commercial and platform teams to meet market demands.


What You’ll Do:

  • Develop and execute regional GTM strategies for new products and market entries.
  • Gather market insights and collaborate cross-functionally to refine propositions.
  • Equip sales teams with powerful tools and narratives to win new business.
  • Monitor performance, optimize offerings, and drive continuous improvement.


Who You Are:

  • 6+ years in proposition development, product marketing, or commercial strategy (B2B/B2B2C tech, financial services, travel, loyalty, or SaaS experience a plus).
  • A data-savvy storyteller with strong stakeholder management skills.
  • Fluent in English; additional regional languages are a bonus.
  • Bonus points for experience in matrixed global organisations or sectors like travel, leisure, or entertainment.


Benefits:

  • Salary up to $120,000
  • 26 days AL
  • Private healthcare
  • Annual salary reviews
  • Rewards platform
  • And more!


Sounds good? Send a copy of your CV to or apply below :)

vagas.title: Senior Backend Engineer (Golang)
vagas.description:
About The Role

We're looking for experienced Senior Golang Engineers to join our growing backend team. You’ll be working on scalable, high-impact systems that support millions of users across some of the world’s most innovative brands. This is a full-time position with a remote-first team that values excellence, ownership, and continuous growth.


What You’ll Do

  • Build and maintain robust backend services in Golang
  • Design scalable solutions with MongoDB for data storage and querying
  • Deploy and manage cloud-native applications using AWS
  • Use Kubernetes for container orchestration and system scalability
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ship impactful features
  • Participate in code reviews and uphold high engineering standards


What We’re Looking For

  • Strong experience developing backend systems in Golang
  • Solid knowledge of MongoDB and NoSQL data modeling
  • Proficiency with AWS services (EC2, S3, RDS, EKS, Lambda, etc.)
  • Hands-on experience with Kubernetes in production environments
  • Solid understanding of software engineering principles, data structures, and algorithms
  • Strong communication and problem-solving skills
  • Availability for at least 6 hours of overlap with US West Coast (PST)


Why Join Kake?

Kake is a remote-first company with a global community — fully believing that it’s not where your table is, but what you bring to the table. We provide top-tier engineering teams to support some of the world’s most innovative companies, and we’ve built a culture where great people stay, grow, and thrive. We’re proud to be more than just a stop along the way in your career — we’re the destination.


The icing on the Kake:

Competitive Pay in USD – Work globally, get paid globally.

Fully Remote – Simply put, we trust you.

Better Me Fund – We invest in your personal growth and passions.

❤️ Compassion is Badass – Join a community that invests in social good.

vagas.description:
Sobre nós

A Atos é uma líder global em transformação digital, com cerca de 94.000 colaboradores e uma receita anual de aproximadamente €11 bilhões de euros. Número um na Europa em cibersegurança, nuvem e computação de alto desempenho, o Grupo oferece soluções personalizadas de ponta a ponta para todos os setores em 69 países. Pioneira em serviços e produtos de descarbonização, a Atos está comprometida com um ambiente digital seguro e descarbonizado para seus clientes. A Atos é uma SE (Societas Europaea) e está listada na Euronext Paris.


------


  • A atuação será part-time em Caxias do Sul/RS - Evetuais idas ao escritório do cliente em semanas específicas no decorrer do projeto - com os devidos reembolsos.
  • As atividades ocorrerão no período tarde/noite até 21h conforme disponibilidade do consultor.



Requisitos :

  • Dominio de SAP versão S/4 Hana, o que difere do SAP ECC, entendimento das novas funcionalidades
  • Conhecimento básico de ABAP para realizar analise de todos os Z-Objects e propor soluções já integradas ao S/4 Hana
  • Conhecimento de SAP FIORI
  • Conhecimento do conceito Clean Core
  • Conhecimento de integrações de SAP com outros sistemas
  • Experiencia em implementação de projeto, configuração e personalização de soluções conforme requisitos do negocio, modelo greenfield e brownfield
  • Conhecimento de processos de negocio

vagas.title: Consultor de CRM
vagas.description:
No momento, estamos procurando um arquiteto técnico-funcional no Dynamics 365 para dar suporte ao nosso maior cliente remotamente no Brasil


Essa é uma função desafiadora que envolve consultoria e engenharia com os principais participantes dos vários mercados da América Latina.


Se você acha que é a pessoa certa para assumir esse desafio, precisará de:

Requisitos mínimos:


  • Ampla experiência técnico-funcional no Dynamics 365
  • Ampla experiência em integrações de Power Platforms e Power Apps com o Dynamics 365
  • Ampla experiência em Gap Analysis e levantamento de requisitos
  • Conhecimento da metodologia Success by Design
  • Ampla experiência em orquestrar o progresso do projeto, envolvendo-se com as partes interessadas sênior.
  • Histórico comprovado de adaptação de metodologia e aplicação de governança para identificar, comunicar e minimizar riscos técnicos e comerciais.


Responsabilidades:

  • Consultas voltadas para o cliente e práticas em vários domínios (varejo, governo, bancos)
  • Realização de workshops avançados para equipes de clientes (prática e teoria)


Se você possui conhecimento profundo e experiência prática nos assuntos acima, este pode ser o próximo grande passo para desenvolver suas habilidades profissionais e técnicas.


Se estiver interessado, candidate-se abaixo e sinta-se à vontade para compartilhar esta publicação com qualquer pessoa relevante.


Estamos ansiosos para receber suas inscrições!


Os candidatos aprovados serão contatados dentro de 2 a 3 semanas após a inscrição

vagas.title: Analista de qualidade de dados
vagas.description:
Sobre a posição

Procuramos um(a) Analista de Qualidade de Dados com perfil analítico, proativo e foco na excelência, para atuar na identificação e resolução de problemas relacionados à qualidade dos dados. O profissional será responsável pelo desenvolvimento de indicadores, criação e manutenção de dashboards em Power BI e análise de dados para garantir que as informações utilizadas pela organização sejam precisas, integrais e confiáveis. Valorizamos profissionais com excelente comunicação, visão sistêmica e habilidades para trabalhar em equipe, colaborando com diferentes áreas da empresa.


Responsabilidades

  • Atuar na análise e resolução de chamados e ocorrências relacionadas à qualidade dos dados, assegurando a consistência e integridade das informações.
  • Desenvolver, monitorar e aprimorar indicadores de qualidade de dados, propondo melhorias contínuas.
  • Criar, implementar e dar manutenção em dashboards interativos e relatórios utilizando Power BI.
  • Realizar extração, manipulação e análise de dados em grandes volumes, utilizando SQL e Python como principais ferramentas.
  • Contribuir com ideias para aprimorar processos de modelagem, análise e visualização de dados.
  • Trabalhar de forma colaborativa com equipes de tecnologia e negócio para garantir a melhor utilização dos dados pela instituição.


Requisitos

  • Ensino superior completo em Tecnologia da Informação, Engenharia da Computação, Ciência da Computação ou áreas afins.
  • Sólida experiência prática com SQL e Python.
  • Forte conhecimento em modelagem de dados.
  • Vivência com análise e visualização de dados, especialmente com Power BI.
  • Experiência em manipulação, tratamento e extração de dados de diferentes fontes e formatos (CSV, Excel, XML, entre outros).
  • Capacidade analítica, atenção aos detalhes e organização para lidar com múltiplas demandas.
  • Boa comunicação e habilidade para trabalhar em equipe.

vagas.title: Scheduling Coordinator
vagas.description:
Together, We Change Lives — Join Our Talent Acquisition Team


We believe in connecting great people to great opportunities. Our work helps shape teams, grow careers, and support the future of technology. We’re partnering with a fast-moving, mission-driven client and are looking for an organized, detail-oriented Recruiting Coordinator to join their remote team.


What You’ll Do


  • Support interview scheduling, reschedules, and calendar coordination across multiple time zones.
  • Work closely with recruiters and hiring managers to ensure a smooth and positive candidate experience.
  • Help manage offer logistics: generate and send offer letters, and track responses.
  • Assist with onboarding and documentation prep.
  • Maintain accurate data and support process consistency in the applicant tracking system (ATS).


Why This Role Matters


  • You’ll help power a high-impact, fast-growing recruiting team.
  • Get exposure to a variety of teams, tools, and workflows.
  • Be part of a collaborative, inclusive, and remote-friendly work culture.
  • This is a great opportunity to grow into recruiting or operations.


What We’re Looking For


  • 1–2 years of experience in recruiting coordination, HR support, or admin roles.
  • Comfort with scheduling, logistics, and using calendars/ATS tools.
  • Strong communication, time management, and organization skills.
  • Ability to work independently and thrive in a remote environment.
  • Bonus: Experience supporting offer or onboarding processes.


Work Environment


  • Fully remote (LATAM preferred )
  • Supportive team culture with lots of learning and growth potential


Equal Opportunity Employer


We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We’re committed to building an inclusive workplace for all applicants and team members, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, identity, orientation, age, or disability.


Diversity fuels our innovation and strengthens our team.


Let me know if you'd like a version optimized for email, job postings, or social media.

vagas.title: Senior Golang Engineer
vagas.description:
Please note that the project operates in the UK time zone.


We are seeking a dedicated, motivated, and reliable Senior Golang Engineer who is interested in providing innovative software solutions for our clients. Be a part of our team as we continue to deliver high quality products and services. The Senior Go Engineer will be responsible for building backend services in Go in EKS, as well as some Lambdas. The overall project will be centered around providing product data and managing the product life cycle. If you are an open communicator with a passion for learning, love to think outside the box and you are excited about software development, we are looking for you!


RESPONSIBILITIES

• Use your deep expertise in Go and related technologies to develop high-quality, scalable, maintainable software solutions.

• Make technically sound decisions and champion high standards of coding and architecture best practices.

• Develop and maintain software documentation such as technical specifications and design documents.

• Continually enhance the team’s performance by mentoring, code reviews, and improving current processes in the SDLC.

• Troubleshoot and debug software issues as they arise.

• Collaborate within a cross functional team and be able to transform both functional and non-functional requirements into actionable work.

• Manage communication of progress/status to stakeholders.


WE ARE LOOKING FOR

• At least 4 years of professional software development experience.

• Proficiency in Go (Golang), including syntax, semantics, database connectivity, and object-oriented concepts.

• Strong understanding of data structures and algorithms.

• Experience working with Go frameworks such as Gin, Revel, Echo, Beego, etc.

• Strong understanding of web services (HTTP, SOAP, REST, GQL, etc.).

• Terraform, Lambdas, Writing API’s.

• Strong working knowledge of relational databases.

• Experience in troubleshooting issues and root cause analysis.

• A proven track record of delivering high quality and tested software on-time and often.

• An open mind, and the patience to explain issues in a constructive manner.

• Strong communication skills, with at least an intermediate level of English.

• Experience working in distributed, cross functional teams.


NICE TO HAVE

• Kubernetes or EKS.

• Algolia.

• Shopify.

• DynamoDB


Who We Are?

We are a fast growing business and technology consultant company co-founded in 2019. We offer a custom-tailored, white-glove engineering service fit for our clients, because a digital transformation is more than just technology. With a successful track record of being a preferred vendor for Fortune 500 companies and as a trusted partner for some of the industry’s leading companies, our global talent has helped many clients achieve their goals.


What's In It For You

  • We offer 100% remote work
  • Wellness/Fitness package
  • Paid trainings and certifications
  • 22 days of paid leave (27 days in the second year with us)
  • Professional Conferences and Training
  • Global Team Building Activities
  • Access to co-working spaces worldwide


Your applications and referrals are welcome!

vagas.title: Key Account Executive
vagas.description:
Key Account Executive (Inglês Fluente)


Posição de Longo Prazo | Empresa Americana | 100% Remoto


A Blue Dot conecta talentos brasileiros a oportunidades internacionais de alto nível. Com mais de 10 anos de experiência em soluções de staffing para empresas nos Estados Unidos, buscamos profissionais ambiciosos para integrar times globais e de alta performance.

Atualmente, representamos uma empresa parceira sediada na Flórida (EUA) que busca um(a) Key Account Executive fluente em inglês, com perfil consultivo, foco em resultados e forte capacidade de relacionamento para atuar na gestão e expansão de contas B2B.


Principais Responsabilidades


  • Gerenciar e expandir uma carteira de clientes norte-americanos, com foco em vendas consultivas B2B
  • Conduzir negociações estratégicas e fechamento de contratos com decisores (C-level)
  • Participar de reuniões e videoconferências em inglês com a liderança da empresa e com os clientes
  • Identificar as necessidades específicas de cada cliente, propondo soluções personalizadas
  • Manter registros atualizados no CRM e acompanhar indicadores de desempenho
  • Construir relacionamentos sólidos e duradouros, promovendo retenção e satisfação dos clientes


Requisitos


  • Inglês fluente (nível C1 ou C2) – toda a comunicação será realizada em inglês, inclusive o processo seletivo
  • Mínimo de 1 ano de experiência com vendas B2B (Sales Executive, SDR, BDR, Inside Sales ou similares)
  • Ensino superior completo ou cursando (EaD aceito)
  • Comunicação clara, postura profissional e habilidade para dialogar com tomadores de decisão
  • Equipamento adequado para videoconferências e uso de CRM (preferencialmente com dois monitores)
  • Disponibilidade para utilizar traje business casual em reuniões virtuais com clientes


Diferenciais


  • Experiência com vendas internacionais ou atendimento a clientes norte-americanos
  • Familiaridade com CRMs e ferramentas de produtividade remota


Remuneração e Condições


  • Remuneração fixa: R$ 4.500,00 (regime PJ)
  • Bonificação mensal em dólares, com base em performance
  • Jornada: Segunda a sexta-feira, das 12h às 21h (1h de intervalo)
  • Posição 100% remota, com plano de carreira e oportunidades reais de crescimento.



Se você busca uma posição estável, com projeção internacional e espaço para crescimento profissional, candidate-se agora e avance para o próximo nível da sua carreira.

Principais Responsabilidades


  • Gerenciar e expandir uma carteira de clientes norte-americanos, com foco em vendas consultivas B2B

vagas.title: Java Backend Engineer - Relocation to Portugal
vagas.description:
Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:

Aubay Portugal is a multinational French company, in Portugal since 2007. We have offices in Lisbon and Oporto and we are a specialized consultant in Management, Implementation, Development and Maintenance of Information Systems. We have more than 150 active partners and we operate in sectors such as banking, insurance, telecommunications, services, energy and transports.


What are we looking for?

  • 5+ years of experience in backend software development;
  • Strong hands-on experience with Spring Boot and microservices architecture;
  • Solid knowledge of cloud environments (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
  • Proven track record in implementation projects (greenfield or legacy modernization);
  • Experience with modern tech stacks (Java 11+, Docker, Kubernetes, etc.);
  • Good level of English, at least B2 (Mandatory);
  • Willingness to move to Portugal (Mandatory).


What do we have to offer you?

  • Health Insurance;
  • Feedback&Coffee – the system that includes Aubay’s Performance Management Cycle, with regular moments of feedback and the Career Progression Model;
  • Working model: hybrid/remote/on-site;
  • A Training Academy designed to think of you and your needs. You can count on technical and behavioural training sessions (e-Learning and classroom), Meet&Techs, Webinars and Mentoring;
  • Events and Teambuildings.


What makes us different?

  • Our organizational culture is based on values such as transparency, team spirit, regular feedback and continuous learning;
  • Reference prizes and birthday present;
  • We don’t have a dress code;
  • We know your name and all address each other informally;
  • You will grow in good company. Isn’t this one of the ways in which to develop professionally?


If we got your attention, we now hope to spark your enthusiasm. Ready for the first phase? We are waiting for you at


Personal Data collected by AUBAY PORTUGAL as Data Controller, regarding the identification, contact and professional capabilities of the candidates, in the present procedure, will be processed for the application analysis, having in consideration that the processing is conducted in order to to take the steps, at the request of the data subject, prior to entering into a contract;

Personal data sent through the present application will be kept by Aubay during the application procedure and will remain stored whilst updated (for one year period). The collected data might be transferred or include other processing actitivites, as long as the data subject is informed, in the occurrence of a standard application and selection procedure, for the compliance of legal obligations for the time required by law. For any queries or request regarding personal data protection rights, the Data Subject may contact AUBAY PORTUGAL’s headquarters in Avenida Duque D`Ávila, nº46 em Lisboa or use the DPO’s e-mail - The Data Subject also has the right to file a complaint with the National Data Protection Authority – (please do not include data regarding racial or ethnical origins, political opinions, religion, philosophy, biometrical data, health data, sexual life and orientation, or relating to o criminal convictions and offences.)

vagas.title: [Fully Remote] Full-stack Product Software Engineer (React, TypeScript, Python, FastAPI, MongoDB)
vagas.description:
Product Software Engineer


Join Oleve as a contract Full-Stack Product Engineer and help us ship features across multiple AI-powered products. You'll work directly with our product team, jumping between projects and contributing to both our existing products like Quizard and Unstuck and new 0-to-1 products we're building from the ground up.


From building responsive React and React native frontends to designing scalable Python backends to integrating AI-powered features, you'll be instrumental in delivering the product experiences that our users love as we scale from thousands to millions of users.


What you'll do:

  • Develop features across 3+ products simultaneously
  • Build responsive frontend interfaces using React and React Native
  • Design and implement scalable backend services and APIs
  • Integrate AI/ML features into product experiences
  • Collaborate closely with our full-time product engineer
  • Write clean, maintainable code that scales with our growth
  • Debug and resolve issues across the full stack


What we're looking for:

  • Proficiency in Python, FastAPI and JavaScript/TypeScript
  • Proficiency in React, React Native, and modern frontend development
  • Strong experience with MongoDB, database design and optimization
  • Strong experience working with LLMs, prompt engineering, and agentic framewrks
  • AWS or cloud platform experience
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work across time zones


Contract Details:

  • Remote work (Brazil/Latin America preferred)
  • Competitive contract rates
  • Hours must overlap with US Eastern time work hours

vagas.title: Senior SAP Developer - Ariba Technical Assessment & Clean Core Compliance
vagas.description:
A Senior SAP Developer is required to conduct a comprehensive technical assessment of an existing SAP Ariba implementation , with a focus on identifying non-compliant configurations , technical debt , and deviations from SAP best practices . The role is critical in evaluating the current build and providing a detailed analysis of areas requiring remediation or potential rebuild.

Participation in remediation or rebuild planning and execution.


Responsibilities:

Review

  • Analyze the current SAP Ariba configuration and custom developments
  • Identify hard-coded logic, non-standard extensions, and unsupported customizations
  • Evaluate the use of SAP APIs, integration methods, and extensibility frameworks

Best Practices and Gap analysis, Clean Core Compliance and Impact evaluation

  • Assess alignment with SAP clean core principles and extensibility guidelines
  • Identify functional and technical gaps impacting business operations
  • Evaluate the scalability, upgradeability, and performance of the current solution
  • Document deviations from SAP-recommended architecture and design patterns
  • Highlight risks associated with technical debt and long-term maintainability
  • Provide recommendations and High level estimation on effort required for remediation, refactoring, or potential rebuild.

Stakeholder Collaboration

  • Work closely with architects and process owners to understand pain points
  • Translate technical findings into business-relevant impacts and priorities

Documentation & Reporting

  • Deliver a comprehensive assessment report detailing findings, risks, and recommendations.


Skills:

  • Advanced or fluent English
  • Experience in SAP development and SAP Ariba (Buying, Sourcing, SLP and Business Network)
  • Deep understanding of SAP Ariba architecture, integration (CIG, APIs), and extensibility
  • Experience in code review, technical audits, and clean core assessments
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail
  • Familiarity with SAP BTP and SAP S/4HANA
  • Experience with common / known integration issues within Ariba, SAP and Fieldglass and its recommended solution
  • Familiarity with punch out catalog and its implementation for Brazil
  • Familiarity with MDG
  • Experience with SAP Fieldglass and S/4HANA procurement modules
  • Experience in Agile methodology usage would be differential
  • SAP certifications would be considered differential


Additional information:

  • Contract: PJ
  • Remote work

  • Evaluate the scalability, upgradeability, and performance of the current solution
  • Document deviations from SAP-recommended architecture and design patterns
  • Highlight risks associated with technical debt and long-term maintainability
  • Provide recommendations and High level estimation on effort required for remediation, refactoring, or potential rebuild.

Stakeholder Collaboration

  • Work closely with architects and process owners to understand pain points
  • Translate technical findings into business-relevant impacts and priorities

Documentation & Reporting

  • Deliver a comprehensive assessment report detailing findings, risks, and recommendations.


Skills:

  • Advanced or fluent English
  • Experience in SAP development and SAP Ariba (Buying, Sourcing, SLP and Business Network)
  • Deep understanding of SAP Ariba architecture, integration (CIG, APIs), and extensibility
  • Experience in code review, technical audits, and clean core assessments
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail
  • Familiarity with SAP BTP and SAP S/4HANA
  • Experience with common / known integration issues within Ariba, SAP and Fieldglass and its recommended solution
  • Familiarity with punch out catalog and its implementation for Brazil
  • Familiarity with MDG
  • Experience with SAP Fieldglass and S/4HANA procurement modules
  • Experience in Agile methodology usage would be differential
  • SAP certifications would be considered differential


Additional information:

  • Contract: PJ
  • Remote work

vagas.title: Especialista em IA Generativa
vagas.description:
Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Projetar, desenvolver e implementar modelos de Inteligência Artificial com foco em soluções práticas e escaláveis;
  • Atuar com Google Cloud Platform (GCP), utilizando seus serviços para orquestração, deploy e escalabilidade de modelos;
  • Programar em Python, aplicando boas práticas de desenvolvimento, versionamento e automação;
  • Integrar e consumir APIs de IA como OpenAI, Microsoft Azure AI e Vertex AI Agent Builder, para desenvolvimento de soluções baseadas em IA Generativa;
  • Aplicar técnicas de Processamento de Linguagem Natural (NLP) e IA Generativa em diferentes contextos de negócio;
  • Realizar a integração de soluções de IA com sistemas e produtos já existentes na empresa;
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares e de negócio, propondo soluções que aliem inovação e viabilidade técnica;
  • Acompanhar as tendências e inovações em IA e tecnologia, mantendo-se atualizado e contribuindo com insights para o time;
  • Garantir a qualidade, robustez e manutenibilidade do código, seguindo as melhores práticas de engenharia de software;
  • Projetar e implementar agentes inteligentes (Intelligent Agents) para diferentes finalidades e interações com usuários.


Requisitos e qualificações

Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento em múltiplas linguagens de programação, com foco em aplicações de IA (ex: Python, JavaScript, etc.);
  • Experiência com APIs de Inteligência Artificial, especialmente OpenAI, Microsoft Azure AI e demais provedores de mercado;
  • Domínio de técnicas de Processamento de Linguagem Natural (NLP), com aplicação prática em projetos reais;
  • Familiaridade com práticas e ferramentas de MLOps para operacionalização, monitoramento e manutenção de modelos em produção.

vagas.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
vagas.description:
About Us:

Bequest.com is a Silicon Valley backed legal-tech company. We build software for trust and estate lawyers, accountants, and professional fiduciaries.


What We're Looking For:

We are looking for a Full-Stack engineer who is extremely experienced in Typescript, ambitious and hardworking. Bequest will continue to grow rapidly and we want our core members to grow with us. This is a startup, the asymmetric risk here should be attractive to you.


You will thrive at Bequest if you can own problems end-to-end, and are willing to pick up knowledge you're missing to get the job done. You will build and learn at a very fast pace with a small but mighty team. If you're ready to take on new challenges and make a real impact, we'd love to hear from you!


Compensation:

Starting salary is 80k USD/year, starting equity is 0.25%.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Frontend: Design and build complex web apps using React, design libraries (like Chakra UI) and state management tools (like Redux or Context)
  • Backend: Use Typescript, Node and NestJS/Express to build a REST API
  • Database: Design database schemas using Prisma and PostgresQL


Required Qualifications:

  • Proficient in English
  • Deep understanding of Typescript (We use it everywhere!)
  • 3+ years designing and developing Frontend applications using React
  • 3+ years developing Backend APIs using NodeJS (We use NestJS)
  • Experience using SQL databases and designing schemas
  • Familiarity with Docker
  • Built production-grade apps with a high bar of quality
  • Strong problem solving skills, high agency and resourceful


Nice to Have:

  • Love Hackathons!
  • Have been an engineer at early-stage company

A Atos é uma empresa líder mundial em transformação digital, oferecendo serviços de transação de alta tecnologia, consultoria, integração de sistemas, cloud e serviços gerenciados. Além disso, anunciada como parceira mundial de TI nos Jogos Olímpicos e Paraolímpicos!


Presente em mais de 70 países e com aproximadamente 100.000 especialistas ao redor do mundo, nossa empresa está no novo ranking Digital 100 da Forbes, uma lista das principais empresas de capital aberto que moldam o mundo digital nas áreas de Tecnologia da Informação (TI), hardware, mídia, e-commerce e telecomunicações.


Buscamos um Analista Desevolvedor Sistemas Java com inglês fluente para atuação em cliente Atos internacional.


Escopo da Atuação:

Desenvolvedor Java com experiência em Spring, WebFlux, Google Cloud Platform (GCP) e Dialogflow para desenvolver e manter um aplicativo de assistente virtual integrado ao Sprinklr como plataforma de interface do usuário.

Experiência consolidade com Java

Spring, WebFlux, Google Cloud Platform (GCP) e Dialogflow

Inglês fluente - irá se comunicar todos os dias em inglês com o cliente que fica nos EUA.


Atuação remota.

  • Plano de saúde extensível a cônjuge e filhos

vagas.title: Talent Data Analyst - Remote
vagas.description:
Recognized as the leading software development company in the Americas, our client offers 100% remote modality and an excellent work environment where employees can thrive, and work in multicultural teams, with flexible schedules and endless growth opportunities.


About the Role:


We are looking for a Talent Data Analyst to join our Talent team. This professional will be responsible for taking raw information – numbers or qualitative data sets – and constructing narratives that help our business colleagues to make better decisions. The primary goal of this position is to take large volumes of complex data from our Talent team, extract insights, and help solve problems.


What You’ll Do:


- Understand the Talent funnel and architect a Data solution from scratch, including the definition of KPIs and metrics.

- Work with stakeholders to understand reporting needs, identifying and querying data sources to get the required data.

- Cleanse and massage data into the shape required, creating datasets, reports, and dashboards to meet requirements.

- Present and gather feedback from stakeholders.

- Deploy data, reports, and dashboards to Data Analysis tools, developing reports according to analyst-defined specifications.

- Maintain and document the operational environment.


You Must Have:


- At least 3 years of experience developing Business Intelligence dashboards and reports, analyzing, and visualizing data.

- An understanding of top-of-the-line Data Analysis tools. Previous experience with administration, licensing, security, and deployment is a plus.

- A solid understanding of the concepts involved in modeling relational data.

- Strong analytic skills, with a hands-on approach with the ability to deliver commitments.

- Superior organizational skills, with a disciplined approach to implementation, support, and documentation.

- Experience with ETL of data from a variety of sources using SSIS, Python, or similar technologies (is a plus).

- Knowledge of SQL Server database architecture (components and processes of the database) and/or experience with creating tabular data models in SQL Server (is a plus).

- Advanced English level.


Benefits:


- 100% remote work.

- Flexible hours - make your own schedule!

- Diverse and multicultural work environment.

- Paid parental leave, vacation & holidays.

- Hardware setup for you to work from home.

- Excellent compensation — well above the market average.

- Extensive opportunities for growth and professional development thanks to our mentoring system.


Enjoy the opportunity to have a dynamic lifestyle, better health, and wellness. Find renewed passion in your job, improve your productivity, and benefit from attractive growth opportunities for your career.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

vagas.title: Recruitment Assistant
vagas.description:
Na Blue Dot, localizada em São Paulo, somos uma empresa de Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) especializada em oferecer soluções perfeitas de staffing para empresas dos Estados Unidos, oferecendo os mais qualificados profissionais para nossos clientes. com uma história de mais de 10 anos, ajudamos dezenas de clientes a suprir suas demandas, bem como milhares de profissionais brasileiros a se destacar, alavancando suas carreiras em grandes players nos Estados unidos.



Responsabilidades: o que você fará?


  • Atuar como Assistant Recruiter, realizando as seguintes tarefas gerais, entre outras:
  • Colaborar com a equipe interna de recrutamento do cliente, proativamente buscando e pré-qualificando candidatos com base em requisições específicas para apresentar como candidatos ativos qualificados.
  • Pré-qualificar talentos por meio de perfis, avaliando nível de interesse e tempo de disponibilidade via chamadas e emails.
  • Manter e atualizar bancos de dados (Dynamics, LinkedIn Recruiter) com informações de candidatos ativos, desenvolvendo e atualizando descrições e especificações de vagas.
  • Executar tarefas administrativas conforme necessário.
  • Identificar talentos em bancos de dados online, listas de contatos, banco de dados interno e indicações para preencher vagas rotineiras e difíceis.
  • Agendar e conduzir entrevistas para avaliar candidatos de forma independente.


Sobre a vaga


  • Remuneração : R$ 3.500,00.
  • Posição 100% Remoto
  • Oportunidade de crescimento até funções gerenciais.
  • Estabilidade: Posição de longo prazo com investimento contínuo na capacitação de nossos assistentes de recrutamento.
  • Treinamento e Capacitação: Oportunidades contínuas de aprimoramento profissional.


Requisitos


  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação em inglês C1 (Nível fluente, tanto verbal quanto escrito).
  • Possuir computador para o trabalho.
  • Possuir internet de alta velocidade

vagas.title: Senior Frontend Developer - Design System
vagas.description:
O que esperamos de você:


Você será a principal referência técnica de frontend na frente de Design System , colaborando com pessoas desenvolvedoras, designers e stakeholders de produto e negócio.


Esperamos que você:

  • Traduza necessidades de produto e design em entregas técnicas escaláveis e bem estruturadas;
  • Atue com autonomia, visão sistêmica e capacidade de abstração para estruturar problemas e orientar o time nas soluções;
  • Garanta excelência técnica nos componentes, fluxos de publicação e documentação, mantendo alta qualidade, performance e usabilidade;
  • Promova cultura de boas práticas de engenharia, acessibilidade e inner-source, sendo referência dentro e fora do time.


O que você vai fazer

  • Conduzir a evolução do nosso Design System multi-marcas , garantindo consistência visual, técnica e de acessibilidade entre os produtos;
  • Liderar iniciativas técnicas como: migração da stack de CSS-in-JS, otimização de performance e SSR, manutenção e organização de monorepo, estruturação de bundling, CI/CD e publicação de pacotes;
  • Trabalhar de forma colaborativa com pessoas de Produto, Design, Dados e Engenharia, promovendo alinhamento e entregas integradas;
  • Contribuir para uma documentação clara, acessível e de fácil uso por outros squads;
  • Ser protagonista na melhoria contínua da developer experience no repositório e incentivar o uso e contribuição por toda a companhia.


Requisitos

  • Proficiência com TypeScript e React;
  • Experiência com ferramentas CSS-in-JS (ex: styled-components, Emotion, etc.);
  • Vivência com monorepos (ex: Lerna, Nx, Turborepo);
  • Experiência com testes unitários e end-to-end;
  • Conhecimento sólido em acessibilidade Web (padrões WCAG).


Diferenciais que somam pontos

  • Experiência prática com Design System e Design Tokens;
  • Vivência em migração de ferramentas CSS-in-JS;
  • Familiaridade com CI/CD (ex: GitHub Actions, Chromatic);
  • Implementação e manutenção de Storybook;
  • Testes de regressão visual;
  • Participação em comunidades técnicas, open source ou iniciativas internas de melhoria contínua.


O que oferecemos

  • Ambiente desafiador com impacto real em produtos utilizados por milhões de pessoas;
  • Liberdade técnica para propor e conduzir melhorias estruturais;
  • Colaboração direta com designers, devs e líderes técnicos altamente capacitados;
  • Cultura de engenharia baseada em aprendizado contínuo, autonomia e excelência.


Se você se identifica com esse desafio e quer construir soluções de escala com propósito, vem com a gente!

vagas.title: Full Stack Engineer | NodeJS/ReactJS
vagas.description:
About Us

Smarter Contact is a fast-growing SaaS with a text and voice messaging communications platform enhanced with AI technologies, serving real estate professionals in the US market. We're the real estate market leader, and we're always looking for performance-driven team members to join our growing team.


We are a fast-paced, Agile environment, ideal for people who thrive in motion, not maintenance. We’re looking for highly collaborative candidates energized by building, scaling, and continuously improving.


About the role:

As we are growing our market presence we are looking for a Full stack Engineer to take ownership of the end-to-end development process, ensuring the delivery of high-quality, scalable, and maintainable software solutions.


If you’ve worked in slow-moving teams or highly-structured corporate settings, this pace might feel intense. But if you’re someone who tackles dynamic challenges, takes ownership fast, and learns from users - you’ll find your place here.


The people who do really well in this role are the ones who love understanding the “why” behind what they’re building. They don’t just write code, but they also heavily focus on how a feature ties into the user journey, how it impacts performance, and what happens next once it’s live. They don’t wait to be told what to do - so proactiveness is highly desired.


Ideal environment for those who love to ask questions, spot gaps, and bring ideas to the table.


Qualifications:

  • 7+ years of proven experience as a Senior Dev within a SaaS or technology-driven company.
  • Strong background in software development, architecture, and technology strategy.
  • Demonstrated success in leading and scaling technology teams in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
  • In-depth knowledge of current and emerging technologies, with a focus on SaaS and cloud-based solutions.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.


Technical Requirements:

  • Proficient in NodeJS for server-side development.
  • Extensive experience in building user interfaces with ReactJS and Typescript
  • Strong expertise in Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including but not limited to Compute Engine, Cloud Functions, Cloud Storage, and Cloud SQL.
  • In-depth knowledge of Postgres database management, including database design, optimization, and maintenance.
  • Preferred background with C# or Onion Architecture
  • Proven experience implementing and applying DDD principles and CQRS patterns in the development of scalable and maintainable systems.
  • Architectural proficiency in designing and implementing scalable, distributed systems.
  • Ability to define and implement microservices architectures for complex applications.
  • Experience working in Agile development environments, with a deep understanding of Agile methodologies and practices.


Nice to Have

  • Prior experience in the messaging space
  • Worked for a fast moving startup


We are looking for the BEST that want to be part of a fast growing company that is set to take off. If you meet ALL of the qualifications, we can't wait to hear from you!

vagas.title: Senior SAP MM Functional Consultant
vagas.description:
About Atos


Atos is a global leader in digital transformation with c. 78,000 employees and annual revenue of c. € 10 billion. European number one in cybersecurity, cloud and high-performance computing, the Group provides tailored end-to-end solutions for all industries in 68 countries. A pioneer in decarbonization services and products, Atos is committed to a secure and decarbonized digital for its clients. Atos is a SE (Societas Europaea) and listed on Euronext Paris.


The purpose of Atos is to help design the future of the information space. Its expertise and services support the development of knowledge, education and research in a multicultural approach and contribute to the development of scientific and technological excellence. Across the world, the Group enables its customers and employees, and members of societies at large to live, work and develop sustainably, in a safe and secure information space.


Senior SAP MM Functional Consultant


Work Location: Remote with occasional visits to the client's office (Rio de Janeiro).


We are looking for a SAP MM Functional Consultant to join our team. If you have solid experience and are committed to results, this could be the opportunity you have been waiting for!


Requirements:

  • Experience in the SAP MM Module, with knowledge of integrations with FI/SD modules, preferably.
  • Proven experience in functional consulting in the MM module.
  • Advanced/Fluent English for communication with the global SAP team and the ability to write functional/technical documentation in English.
  • Degree in technology courses.
  • Certification in MM Academy will be considered a differential.
  • Proactive and committed.


Benefits Offered:

  • Meal Voucher
  • Health Insurance
  • Dental Insurance
  • Variable Compensation Program
  • Childcare Assistance
  • Wellhub
  • Pharmacy Partnerships
  • Private Pension Plan
  • Life Insurance
  • Payroll Loans
  • Partnerships with Partner Companies
  • Subsidy Policy for Postgraduate Studies
  • Speexx
  • Training Programs
  • Corporate University
  • Health Space
  • Online Therapy
  • Pregnancy Support Program
  • My New Trust Partnership Program
  • Day Off on Your Birthday
  • Partnership with Samsung
  • Referral Bonus
  • Jubilee
  • Accolade


Diversity:

We are committed to promoting diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and experiences.

vagas.title: Sr Software Engineer
vagas.description:
ABOUT US

Syniti is the enterprise data partner, empowering anyone who relies on data to make business-critical decisions by delivering data they can trust through a unique combination of intelligent software and experts who deeply understand the role of data in enterprise growth.

Trusted by the Fortune 2000, Syniti helps leading businesses reconfigure the role of enterprise data from afterthought to foundational first step; enabling them to unlock valuable insights that ignite growth, reduce risk, and expand their competitive advantage.

Syniti’s Data First philosophy and enterprise data management platform supports data migration, data quality, data replication, data matching, master data management, analytics, data governance, and data strategy in a single, unified solution.

As an innovative, global leader in Enterprise Data Management, the combination of our award-winning software platform and premier consultants creates a unique advantage for leading enterprises. Syniti is also a preferred data solution used by the world’s top system integrators. Headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts with offices in 25 countries around the world, Syniti operates in all global regions and industry verticals, and maintains a 100% client success rate across thousands of complex data projects and initiatives.


The ROLE

The Senior Software Engineer assumes a leadership role in our technical endeavors, significantly shaping the architecture, design, and implementation of our systems. Apart from mastering our tech stack, they take pride in mentoring fellow engineers and proactively identifying areas of technical improvement, breaking down complex challenges into actionable tasks.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Lead technical projects, contributing to architecture, design, and system implementation.
  • Address and reduce technical debt proactively.
  • Mentor and guide less experienced engineers.
  • Break down and delegate complex problems for team execution.

WHAT IT TAKES

  • 5+ years of relevant experience in full-stack software development.
  • Advanced full-stack skills including Go or C#, AWS, React, and Typescript/JS.
  • Advanced knowledge in SQL, NoSQL, or graph databases.
  • Proficiency with CI/CD and DevOps techniques and best practices.
  • Proficient in writing secure, production-ready code with a deep domain understanding.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead, mentor, and think strategically.
  • Operate with minimal supervision and be proactive in task leadership.
  • Significant impact on product quality and design simplification.
  • Be fully aligned to the our core values:

o Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have.

o Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday.

o Take Action - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day.

o Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family.


WHAT WE OFFER

  • Trust that you are good at what you’re doing. At Syniti you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our thing.
  • Growth . We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story.
  • Support . We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone.
  • Curiosity and genuine interest in you . We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating with each depicting a different journey and we want to hear them all.
  • Recognition . We are the sum of individual achievements and we always take the time to celebrate them.
  • An open organisation . Hierarchies are not our thing and access is something we make sure of across the board. We are a family where everyone is just as important, everyone’s work is seen and ideas valued.


Our Commitment to Inclusion


At Syniti, we’re committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team.

We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we’re dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we’re here to support you.

vagas.title: WFH Opportunity (Personalized Internet Assessor)
vagas.description:
Looking for a freelance opportunity where you can make an impact on technology from the comfort of your home? If you are dynamic, tech-savvy, and always online to learn more, this part-time, flexible project is the perfect fit for you!


A Day in the Life of a Personalized Internet Assessor:

  • In this role, you’ll be analyzing and providing feedback on texts, pages, images, and other types of information for top search engines, using an online tool
  • Through reviewing and rating search results for relevance and quality, you’ll be helping to improve the overall user experience for millions of search engine users, including yourself.


Join our team today and start putting your skills to work for one of the world's leading search engines.


The estimated hourly earnings for this role are 5.00 USD per hour. Payment is based on completed tasks, with the potential for higher earnings based on productivity.


TELUS Digital AI Community

Our global AI Community is a vibrant network of 1 million+ contributors from diverse backgrounds who help our customers collect, enhance, train, translate, and localize content to build better AI models. Become part of our growing community and make an impact supporting the machine learning models of some of the world’s largest brands.


Qualification path


No previous professional experience is required to apply to this role, however, working on this project will require you to pass the basic requirements and go through a standard assessment process. This is a part-time long-term project and your work will be subject to our standard quality assurance checks during the term of this agreement.


Basic Requirements

  • Working as a freelancer with excellent communication skills in Portuguese
  • Being a resident in Brazil for the last 5 consecutive years and having familiarity with current and historical business, media, sport, news, social media, and cultural affairs in Brazil
  • Active use of Gmail, Google+, and other forms of social media and experience in the use of web browsers to navigate and interact with a variety of content
  • Daily access to a broadband internet connection, a smartphone (Android 5.0, iOS 14 or higher), and a personal computer to work on.


Assessment

In order to be hired into the program, you’ll take a language assessment and an open book qualification exam that will determine your suitability for the position and complete ID verification. Don’t worry, our team will provide you with guidelines and learning materials before your exam. You will be required to complete the exam in a specific timeframe but at your convenience!


Equal Opportunity

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for a contractual relationship without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status. At TELUS Digital AI, we are proud to offer equal opportunities and are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive community. All aspects of selection are based on applicants’ qualifications, merits, competence, and performance without regard to any characteristic related to diversity.

vagas.description:

Como Analista de Growth Marketing Pleno  sua missão será impulsionar nossas estratégias de aquisição, contribuindo diretamente para o crescimento e a escalabilidade da Nexti.

  • Será responsável por apoiar a construção e execução de iniciativas de growth com foco principal em aquisição de novos clientes, atuando de forma estratégica e orientada a dados.
  • Fará parte da expansão das nossas frentes de aquisição para produtos B2B2C, ajudando a estruturar processos, canais e campanhas voltadas a esse novo público — sem perder o foco na operação já consolidada para B2B.


Se você tem perfil analítico, visão estratégica de negócios, domina ferramentas e táticas de marketing digital e automação, e gosta de atuar com foco em resultados, essa vaga é para você!


Requisitos:

  • Experiência em growth marketing, com foco em aquisição, preferencialmente em empresas SaaS, HR Techs ou B2B/B2B2C.
  • Experiência em gestão de campanhas pagas de mídia digital.
  • Domínio de CRM e ferramentas de automação de marketing (RD Station, Pipedrive, Make ou similares).
  • Noções de segmentação, tracking e análise de dados de campanhas.
  • Experiência com criação de fluxos omnichannel, integrações no-code e automações.
  • Capacidade analítica, com cultura orientada a dados e tomada de decisão baseada em métricas.
  • Noções de ferramentas de analytics e dashboards.
  • Excel avançado ou Google Sheets (com fórmulas complexas, segmentações, cruzamentos de dados).

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência em aquisição B2B2C e estruturação de estratégias para esse público.
  • Vivência com estratégias e ferramentas de ABM.
  • Experiência prévia em contextos de Revenue Ops.
  • Inglês intermediário ou avançado.


Benefícios:

️ VA/VR Nexti Flex no valor de R$ 880,00 (mensais fixos);

vagas.title: Analista de Growth Marketing PL
vagas.description:
Somos uma HRtech, e nossa missão é tornar relações trabalhistas mais simples, eﬁcientes e justas

Como Analista de Growth Marketing Pleno  sua missão será impulsionar nossas estratégias de aquisição, contribuindo diretamente para o crescimento e a escalabilidade da Nexti.

  • Será responsável por apoiar a construção e execução de iniciativas de growth com foco principal em aquisição de novos clientes, atuando de forma estratégica e orientada a dados.
  • Fará parte da expansão das nossas frentes de aquisição para produtos B2B2C, ajudando a estruturar processos, canais e campanhas voltadas a esse novo público — sem perder o foco na operação já consolidada para B2B.


Se você tem perfil analítico, visão estratégica de negócios, domina ferramentas e táticas de marketing digital e automação, e gosta de atuar com foco em resultados, essa vaga é para você!


Requisitos:

  • Experiência em growth marketing, com foco em aquisição, preferencialmente em empresas SaaS, HR Techs ou B2B/B2B2C.
  • Experiência em gestão de campanhas pagas de mídia digital.
  • Domínio de CRM e ferramentas de automação de marketing (RD Station, Pipedrive, Make ou similares).
  • Noções de segmentação, tracking e análise de dados de campanhas.
  • Experiência com criação de fluxos omnichannel, integrações no-code e automações.
  • Capacidade analítica, com cultura orientada a dados e tomada de decisão baseada em métricas.
  • Noções de ferramentas de analytics e dashboards.
  • Excel avançado ou Google Sheets (com fórmulas complexas, segmentações, cruzamentos de dados).

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência em aquisição B2B2C e estruturação de estratégias para esse público.
  • Vivência com estratégias e ferramentas de ABM.
  • Experiência prévia em contextos de Revenue Ops.
  • Inglês intermediário ou avançado.


Benefícios:

️ VA/VR Nexti Flex no valor de R$ 880,00 (mensais fixos);

‍⚕️Plano de saúde Unimed;

vagas.title: Engenheiro de Software Backend IA
vagas.description:
Estamos em busca de uma pessoa desenvolvedora com foco em soluções de IA Generativa , que seja apaixonada por arquiteturas escaláveis, automações e inteligência conversacional. Buscamos alguém com domínio de Python e experiência prática com soluções modernas de IA aplicadas ao mercado real — especialmente com agentes autônomos, RAG e integrações em nuvem.


Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver e manter backends orientados a modelos de linguagem , utilizando LangChain , RAG e arquiteturas baseadas em agentes (multi-agent systems);
  • Construir e orquestrar fluxos com filas (SQS) para garantir escalabilidade e processamento assíncrono;
  • Implementar soluções de IA generativa aplicadas a assistentes virtuais e automações;
  • Realizar integrações com serviços AWS (Lambda, S3, DynamoDB, SQS, etc.);
  • Monitorar o desempenho de agentes e sistemas de IA em produção, ajustando quando necessário;
  • Colaborar com times de produto, dados e engenharia para evoluir continuamente a arquitetura.


Qualificações obrigatórias:

  • Domínio de Python ;
  • Experiência prática com LangChain e/ou frameworks similares de orquestração de LLMs;
  • Conhecimento sobre RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) e integração com vetores;
  • Experiência com AWS , especialmente SQS , Lambda, DynamoDB e S3;
  • Vivência em arquiteturas com agentes autônomos (multi-agents) ;
  • Familiaridade com consumo de APIs de LLMs (como OpenAI);
  • Capacidade de documentar, testar e manter código escalável e sustentável;
  • Conhecimento sólido em bibliotecas de IA como TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn, e similares;
  • Experiência em desenvolvimento e integração de chatbots.


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com MLOps ou deploy de modelos em produção;
  • Conhecimentos em bancos vetoriais como Pinecone , FAISS ou Weaviate ;
  • Noções de arquitetura de microsserviços e mensageria distribuída.


Benefícios:

  • Assistência odontológica
  • Empréstimo consignado
  • Plano de carreira
  • Seguro de vida
  • Vale refeição
  • Assistência médica
  • Programa de orientação pessoal - C4 Life
  • Day Off
  • Vale alimentação


Local de trabalho

Rua José Versolato, Centro, São Bernardo do Campo - São Paulo, 09750-730, Brasil
